author: Eadweard Muybridge, Animal Locomotion, Plate 2 (1887); GIF Jjkutch (2013)
transforms: Decode GIF composited frames; select every second frame. Individual frames retain original dimensions. Contact sheet scaled uniformly. No AI alteration. Loop display speed 170ms/frame is a review setting, not original recording timing.
constraints: Original photography has natural elbow flexion. Straight elbows are a later stylization, not a property of this reference.
Track anatomical limbs across all six frames, including hidden limbs. Do not infer limb identity from screen-left/right position.
Future rig: keep neck anchor and torso proportions of existing game body; convert reference motion to that rig before drawing clothes.
Future costume generation must preserve rig joints, near/far layer order and six-frame phase order.
Do not replace runtime sprites until visual validation of opposite arm/leg swing and two alternating steps.
